summary: Community Bancorp/VT filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, reporting that its board declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.26 per share, payable November 1, 2026 to holders of record October 15, 2026. The filing is an Item 8.01/9.01 current report with the press release attached as Exhibit 99.1; the Nasdaq-listed common stock trades as CMTV. No advisor, premium, stake, deal value, or transaction mechanics are stated because no M&A, tender, strategic-review, or capital-return special situation beyond an ordinary dividend occurred. No risk-arb angle applies.
